### Proptest invariants

Extend `tests/proptest_state_machines/data_display.rs` with:

- Strategy for arbitrary `Props` (id, mode, behavior, disabled set,
  disallow_empty_selection bool, default selected set).
- Strategy for arbitrary `Event` (all 14 events with bounded keys/cols).
- Invariants after any sequence of `<=64` events:
  - `ctx.selected_rows.get()` only contains keys never marked disabled.
  - `ctx.expanded_rows.get()` only contains rows never disabled.
  - When `disallow_empty_selection` and any default selection was set,
    selection is non-empty.
  - `ctx.column_widths` values all `>= 50.0`.
  - `ctx.focused_cell.map(|(c, _)| c < ctx.total_cols)` is true when
    virtual scrolling is on.

Marked `#[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]` per the
workspace convention.

## Reused existing utilities (no re-implementation)

- `ars_collections::Key` — row identifiers.
- `ars_collections::selection::{Set, State, Mode, Behavior}` — selection

  HasId, MessageFn, ComponentMessages, TransitionPlan, NoEffect,
  Direction, Env, Locale}` — same imports as Tabs.
- `ars_interactions::KeyboardEventData` — passed into keydown helpers.

20	### 1.1 States
21	
22	| State  | Description                           |
23	| ------ | ------------------------------------- |
24	| `Idle` | No active sort; the table is at rest. |
25	
26	#### 1.1.1 Sort State Single Source of Truth
27	
28	Table sort state is managed exclusively through `Context.sort_descriptor: Bindable<Option<SortDescriptor>>`. There is NO `State::Sorting` variant in the state enum — the Table state machine uses only `Idle`, `Scrolling`, and other interaction states.
29	
30	**Rationale**: Having both a `State::Sorting` variant and a `Context.sort_descriptor` created a sync race where the state and context could disagree about the current sort. By using `Context.sort_descriptor` as the single source of truth:
31	
32	- External prop changes to `sort_descriptor` are immediately reflected
33	- No state/context synchronization logic needed
34	- The Bindable pattern handles controlled vs uncontrolled sort seamlessly
35	
36	**Visual Feedback**: For components that need to show a sorting indicator (e.g., spinner while async sort completes), use `Context.is_sorting: bool`:
37	
38	```rust
39	/// Context for the Table
40	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
41	pub struct TableContext {
42	    /// The current sort configuration. Single source of truth for sort state.
43	    pub sort_descriptor: Bindable<Option<SortDescriptor>>,
44	    /// True while an async sort operation is in progress. Used for visual feedback only.
45	    pub is_sorting: bool,
46	    // ... other fields
47	}
48	```
49	
50	When a sort column header is clicked:
51	
52	1. Update `sort_descriptor` via Bindable (handles controlled/uncontrolled)
53	2. Set `is_sorting = true`
54	3. Emit `on_sort_change` callback
55	4. When sort completes (sync or async): set `is_sorting = false`
56	
57	### 1.2 Events
58	
59	| Event         | Payload                | Description                                   |
60	| ------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
61	| `SortColumn`  | `column: String`       | Apply or toggle sort on the given column.     |
62	| `SelectRow`   | `Key` (row id)         | Mark a row as selected.                       |
63	| `DeselectRow` | `Key` (row id)         | Remove a row from the selection.              |
64	| `SelectAll`   | —                      | Select all rows (uses `selection::Set::All`). |
65	| `DeselectAll` | —                      | Clear all selected rows.                      |
66	| `ToggleRow`   | `Key` (row id)         | Flip selection state of one row.              |
67	| `ExpandRow`   | `Key` (row id)         | Show the expanded content for a row.          |
68	| `CollapseRow` | `Key` (row id)         | Hide the expanded content for a row.          |
69	| `Focus`       | `cell: (usize, usize)` | Move the logical grid focus to a cell.        |
70	| `Blur`        | —                      | Remove focus from the grid.                   |
71	| `RowAction`   | `Key` (row id)         | Primary action triggered on a row.            |
72	
73	### 1.3 Context
74	
75	```rust

77	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
78	pub struct Context {
79	    /// Currently selected row IDs (uses canonical `selection::Set` from `ars_collections`).
80	    pub selected_rows: Bindable<selection::Set>,
81	    /// Full selection state machine (mode, behavior, anchor, focus, disabled keys).
82	    pub selection_state: selection::State,
83	    /// Currently expanded row IDs (expansion ≠ selection; remains `BTreeSet`).
84	    pub expanded_rows: Bindable<BTreeSet<Key>>,
85	    /// Unified sort state: which column is sorted and in which direction.
86	    /// `None` means no active sort. Uses `SortDescriptor` from `ars_collections`.
87	    pub sort_descriptor: Bindable<Option<SortDescriptor<String>>>,
88	    /// Grid focus position: (col_index, row_index). None when unfocused.
89	    pub focused_cell: Option<(usize, usize)>,
90	    /// Focused row ID for row-level keyboard navigation.
91	    pub focused_row: Option<Key>,
92	    /// Focused column index for cell-level keyboard navigation.
93	    pub focused_col: Option<usize>,
94	    /// Keys of individually disabled rows.

246	
247	### 1.6 Async Data Loading
248	
249	Tables support asynchronous data loading for large datasets:
250	
251	```rust,no_check
252	    /// Whether the table is currently loading data.
253	    /// When `true`, the adapter renders skeleton placeholder rows.
254	    pub loading: Bindable<bool>,
255	
256	    /// Callback triggered when the user scrolls near the end of the table,
257	    /// enabling infinite scroll / load-more patterns.
258	    pub on_load_more: Option<Callback<()>>,
259	```
260	
261	- When `loading` is `true`, the adapter renders a loading indicator in the table footer area and displays skeleton rows in place of data rows.
262	- `on_load_more` fires when the scroll position reaches within a threshold of the table's scroll end (adapter-defined, typically ~200px). It is debounced to fire at most once per 300ms.
263	- While `loading` is `true`, `on_load_more` is suppressed to prevent duplicate requests.
264	
265	```rust
266	impl Default for Props {
267	    fn default() -> Self {
268	        Self {
269	            id: String::new(),
270	            selected_rows: None,
271	            default_selected_rows: selection::Set::default(),
272	            expanded_rows: None,
273	            default_expanded_rows: BTreeSet::new(),
274	            sort_descriptor: Bindable::uncontrolled(None),
275	            selection_mode: selection::Mode::None,
276	            selection_behavior: selection::Behavior::Toggle,
277	            disabled_keys: BTreeSet::new(),
278	            escape_key_behavior: EscapeKeyBehavior::ClearSelection,
279	            interactive: false,
280	            sticky_header: false,
281	            caption: None,
282	            disallow_empty_selection: false,
283	        }
284	    }

347	use ars_core::{TransitionPlan, ComponentIds, AttrMap, Bindable};
348	use ars_collections::{selection, Key};
349	
350	// ── States ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
351	
352	/// States for the Table.
353	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
354	pub enum State {
355	    /// No active sort; the table is at rest.
356	    Idle,
357	}
358	
359	// ── Events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
360	
361	/// Events for the Table.
362	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
363	pub enum Event {
364	    /// Apply or toggle sort on the given column.
365	    SortColumn { column: String },
366	    /// Mark a row as selected.
367	    SelectRow(Key),
368	    /// Remove a row from the selection.
369	    DeselectRow(Key),
370	    /// Select all rows (uses `selection::Set::All`).
371	    SelectAll,
372	    /// Clear all selected rows.
373	    DeselectAll,
374	    /// Flip selection state of one row.
375	    ToggleRow(Key),
376	    /// Show the expanded content for a row.
377	    ExpandRow(Key),
378	    /// Hide the expanded content for a row.
379	    CollapseRow(Key),
380	    /// Move the logical grid focus to a cell.
381	    Focus { cell: (usize, usize) },
382	    /// Remove focus from the grid.
383	    Blur,
384	    /// Move the logical grid focus to a row.
385	    FocusRow(Key),
386	    /// Move the logical grid focus to a cell.
387	    FocusCell { row: Key, col: usize },
388	    /// Primary action triggered on a row (Enter key or double-click).
389	    RowAction(Key),
390	}
391	
392	/// Machine for the Table.
393	pub struct Machine;
394	
395	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
396	    type State   = State;
397	    type Event   = Event;
398	    type Context = Context;
399	    type Props   = Props;
400	    type Messages = Messages;
401	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
402	
403	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
404	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
405	        let messages = messages.clone();
406	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
407	        let selection_state = selection::State::new(
408	            props.selection_mode,
409	            props.selection_behavior,
410	        );
411	        let ctx = Context {
412	            selected_rows: match &props.selected_rows {
413	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
414	                None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_selected_rows.clone()),
415	            },
416	            selection_state,
417	            expanded_rows: match &props.expanded_rows {
418	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
419	                None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_expanded_rows.clone()),
420	            },
421	            sort_descriptor: props.sort_descriptor.clone(),
422	            focused_cell: None,
423	            focused_row: None,
424	            focused_col: None,
425	            disabled_keys: props.disabled_keys.clone(),
426	            selection_mode: props.selection_mode,
427	            interactive: props.interactive,
428	            locale,
429	            messages,
430	            caption_id: ids.part("caption"),
431	            id: ids.id().to_string(),
432	        };
433	        (State::Idle, ctx)
434	    }
435	
436	    fn transition(
437	        state: &Self::State,
438	        event: &Self::Event,
439	        ctx:   &Self::Context,
440	        props: &Self::Props,
441	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
442	        match event {
443	            // ── Sort ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
444	            // Sort state lives entirely in `ctx.sort_descriptor` (see §1.1.1).
445	            // There is no State::Sorting variant — we stay in `Idle` throughout.
446	            Event::SortColumn { column } => {
447	                let new_direction = match ctx.sort_descriptor.get() {
448	                    Some(desc) if desc.column == *column => {
449	                        match desc.direction {
450	                            SortDirection::Ascending  => SortDirection::Descending,
451	                            SortDirection::Descending => SortDirection::None,
452	                            SortDirection::None       => SortDirection::Ascending,
453	                        }
454	                    }
455	                    // New column — always start ascending
456	                    _ => SortDirection::Ascending,
457	                };
458	                let col = column.clone();
459	                let dir = new_direction;
460	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
461	                    let descriptor = if dir == SortDirection::None {
462	                        None
463	                    } else {
464	                        Some(SortDescriptor { column: col, direction: dir })
465	                    };
466	                    ctx.sort_descriptor.set(descriptor);
467	                }))
468	                // Sort change notification is handled by the adapter layer.
469	            }
470	
471	            // ── Row Action ────────────────────────────────────────────────
472	            Event::RowAction(key) => {
473	                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) { return None; }
474	                // RowAction is a notification event — the adapter fires the
475	                // on_row_action callback. No context mutation needed.
476	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|_ctx| {}))
477	            }
478	
479	            // ── Row Selection (via selection::State from ars_collections) ────────
480	            Event::SelectRow(key) => {
481	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
482	                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) { return None; }
483	                let key = key.clone();
484	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
485	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select(key);
486	                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
487	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
488	                }))
489	            }
490	
491	            Event::DeselectRow(key) => {
492	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
493	                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) { return None; }
494	                let key = key.clone();
495	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
496	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.deselect(key);
497	                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
498	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
499	                }))
500	            }
501	
502	            Event::ToggleRow(key) => {
503	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
504	                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) { return None; }
505	                let key = key.clone();
506	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
507	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.toggle(key);
508	                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
509	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
510	                }))
511	            }
512	
513	            Event::SelectAll => {
514	                if ctx.selection_mode != selection::Mode::Multiple { return None; }
515	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
516	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select_all();
517	                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
518	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
519	                    // LiveAnnouncer: announce "All rows selected"
520	                }))
521	            }
522	
523	            Event::DeselectAll => {
524	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
525	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
526	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.clear();
527	                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
528	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
529	                }))
530	            }
531	
532	            // ── Row Expansion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
533	            Event::ExpandRow(key) => {
534	                // Guard: skip when the row is already expanded — avoids
535	                // creating an unnecessary transition plan.
536	                if ctx.expanded_rows.get().contains(key) {
537	                    return None;
538	                }
539	                let key = key.clone();

1163	- **Expand Trigger**: Each expandable row includes a toggle button (typically a chevron icon) as the first cell or as an overlay on the row. The trigger receives `aria-expanded="true|false"` reflecting the current state. The trigger button MUST also set `aria-controls` pointing to the `id` of the detail row so assistive technology can navigate directly to the expanded content.
1164	- **Content Area**: Expanded content is rendered as a full-width `<td colspan="...">` (spanning all columns) inside a `<tr>` immediately below the parent row.
1165	- **Toggle Anatomy**: The expand/collapse control is a `<button>` element with `aria-label` describing the action (e.g., "Expand row" / "Collapse row"), managed via the `Messages` i18n struct.
1166	
1167	#### 2.2.1 Nesting Rules
1168	
1169	- **Single-level expansion only**: Expandable rows support one level of expansion. A row can expand to show detail content, but the detail content MUST NOT itself contain expandable rows. Nested expansion introduces unpredictable keyboard navigation and screen reader confusion.
1170	- **Hierarchical data**: For tree-structured or multi-level hierarchical data, use the `TreeView` component instead of nested table expansion. TreeView provides proper `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, and `aria-posinset` attributes for arbitrary nesting depth.
1171	- **Indentation Level**: Since expansion is single-level, `aria-level` attributes are not used on expandable rows. All data rows are at the same level; expanded content is supplementary detail, not a child row.
1172	
1173	## 3. Accessibility
1174	
1175	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
1176	
1177	- **role="grid"** when `interactive=true`; **role="table"** otherwise.
1178	- Sortable `ColumnHeader`: `aria-sort="ascending|descending|none"`. Enter/Space toggles sort.
1179	- `Row`: `aria-selected` present only when `selection_mode != None`.
1180	- `Row` with expand: `aria-expanded="true|false"`.
1181	- `SelectAllCheckbox`: `aria-checked="mixed"` (indeterminate) when a subset of rows selected.
1182	
1183	**`aria-sort` and `aria-current` Semantics**
1184	
1185	- Sortable column headers MUST set `aria-sort` to one of: `"ascending"`, `"descending"`, or `"none"`.
1186	- When a column is not currently sorted, set `aria-sort="none"` (not omitted) so screen readers can distinguish sortable from non-sortable columns.
1187	- When sort state changes (user clicks a column header), announce the new sort state via `LiveAnnouncer` with `Politeness::Polite`: e.g., `"Sorted by Name, ascending"`. Use the `Messages.sort_ascending` / `Messages.sort_descending` message keys.
1188	
1189	**Pagination `aria-current`:**
1190	
1191	- When Table includes pagination controls, the active page button MUST set `aria-current="page"` to indicate the current page to screen readers.
1192	- Other page buttons MUST NOT have `aria-current` set (omit the attribute entirely, do not set to `"false"`).
1193	
1194	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
1195	
1196	Grid keyboard navigation (when `interactive=true`):
1197	
1198	| Key          | Action                                                                                   |
1199	| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
1200	| `ArrowUp`    | Move focus to the cell above                                                             |
1201	| `ArrowDown`  | Move focus to the cell below                                                             |
1202	| `ArrowLeft`  | Move focus to the previous cell (wraps to previous row)                                  |
1203	| `ArrowRight` | Move focus to the next cell (wraps to next row)                                          |
1204	| `Home`       | Move focus to the first cell in the current row                                          |
1205	| `End`        | Move focus to the last cell in the current row                                           |
1206	| `Ctrl+Home`  | Move focus to the first cell in the first row                                            |
1207	| `Ctrl+End`   | Move focus to the last cell in the last row                                              |
1208	| `Enter`      | Activate the focused cell's primary interactive content                                  |
1209	| `F2`         | Enter edit mode for the focused cell (if editable)                                       |
1210	| `Escape`     | Exit edit mode, return focus to the cell                                                 |
1211	| `Space`      | Select/deselect the focused row (if selection enabled)                                   |
1212	| `Tab`        | Move focus to the next focusable element inside the cell; if none, move to the next cell |
1213	
1214	### 3.3 Focus Management
1215	
1216	- When `interactive=true`, the Table renders `role="grid"` and manages a roving `tabindex` across cells. The currently focused cell has `tabindex="0"`; all other cells have `tabindex="-1"`.
1217	- On initial focus (Tab into the grid), focus lands on the first cell of the first data row (or the last-focused cell if one was previously focused).
1218	- Arrow keys move focus between cells without wrapping out of the grid. `Home`/`End` wrap within the current row; `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` move to the first/last cell of the first/last row.
1219	- When a cell contains interactive content (links, buttons, inputs), `Enter` activates it and `Escape` returns focus to the cell container.
1220

1259	
1260	#### 3.4.2 `aria-sort` Attribute
1261	
1262	Each sortable `<th>` element MUST carry the `aria-sort` attribute reflecting its current
1263	sort state:
1264	
1265	| Sort State | `aria-sort` Value |
1266	| ---------- | ----------------- |
1267	| Ascending  | `"ascending"`     |
1268	| Descending | `"descending"`    |
1269	| Unsorted   | `"none"`          |
1270	
1271	Non-sortable columns MUST NOT include `aria-sort`.
1272	
1273	#### 3.4.3 Live Region Announcement Timing
1274	
1275	When a sort operation completes (i.e., the data has been reordered and the DOM updated),
1276	the adapter MUST inject the appropriate message into an `aria-live="polite"` live region.
1277	The announcement fires immediately after the sort transition — no artificial delay.
1278	
1279	For single-column sort, the adapter uses `sort_ascending` or `sort_descending` with the
1280	column name substituted. When sort is removed, `sort_none` is used.
1281	
1282	For multi-column sort, the adapter uses `multi_sort_changed` with a formatted list of all
1283	active sort columns and their directions, ordered by sort priority (primary first).

//! Checkbox component state machine and connect API.
//!
//! This module implements the framework-agnostic `Checkbox` machine defined in
//! `spec/components/input/checkbox.md`. The machine owns tri-state checked
//! state, focus-visible state, form metadata, and ARIA wiring for every anatomy
//! part.

use alloc::{string::String, vec::Vec};
use core::fmt::{self, Debug};

use ars_core::{
    AriaAttr, AttrMap, Bindable, Callback, ComponentIds, ComponentPart, ConnectApi, Env, HtmlAttr,
    PendingEffect, TransitionPlan, no_cleanup,
};
use ars_interactions::keyboard::{KeyboardEventData, KeyboardKey};

/// The checked state of the component.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum State {
    /// The component is unchecked.
    Unchecked,

    /// The component is checked.
    Checked,

    /// The component is indeterminate.
    Indeterminate,
}

/// Events for the Checkbox component.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Event {
    /// Flip between `Unchecked` and `Checked`; exits `Indeterminate` to `Checked`.
    Toggle,

    /// Transition to `Checked`.
    Check,

    /// Transition to `Unchecked`.
    Uncheck,

    /// Restore checked state to [`Props::default_checked`] for form resets.
    Reset,

    /// Synchronize the externally controlled checked prop.
    SetValue(Option<State>),

    /// Synchronize output-affecting props stored in context.
    SetProps,

    /// Track whether a description part is rendered.
    SetHasDescription(bool),

    /// Focus received.
    Focus {
        /// True if the focus was initiated by a keyboard.
        is_keyboard: bool,
    },

    /// Focus lost.
    Blur,
}

/// Context for the Checkbox component.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Context {
    /// Current checked state, controlled or uncontrolled.
    pub checked: Bindable<State>,

    /// Whether the component is disabled.
    pub disabled: bool,

    /// Whether the component is required.
    pub required: bool,

    /// Whether the component is invalid.
    pub invalid: bool,

    /// Whether the component is readonly.
    pub readonly: bool,

    /// Whether the component is focused.
    pub focused: bool,

    /// True when focus came from keyboard and should show a visible focus ring.
    pub focus_visible: bool,

    /// The name attribute for form submission.
    pub name: Option<String>,

    /// Returns the number of selected items, or `None` for `All`.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn count(&self) -> Option<usize> {
        match self {
            Self::Empty => Some(0),
            Self::Single(_) => Some(1),
            Self::Multiple(keys) => Some(keys.len()),
            Self::All => None,
        }
    }

    /// Returns the number of selected items.
    ///
    /// `All` returns `0`; callers that need to distinguish that case should
    /// prefer [`Self::count`].
    #[must_use]
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.count().unwrap_or(0)
    }

    /// Iterates over the selected keys.
    ///
    /// `All` returns an empty iterator because it must be resolved against a
    /// concrete collection.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn keys(&self) -> Box<dyn Iterator<Item = &Key> + '_> {
        match self {
            Self::Empty | Self::All => Box::new(core::iter::empty()),
            Self::Single(key) => Box::new(core::iter::once(key)),
            Self::Multiple(keys) => Box::new(keys.iter()),
        }
    }

    /// Toggles the selection state of `key`.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn toggle<T, C: Collection<T>>(&self, key: Key, collection: &C) -> Self {
        if self.is_selected(&key) {
            match &self.selected_keys {
                Set::All => self.deselect_from_all(&key, collection),

                _ => self.deselect(&key),
            }
        } else {
            self.select(key)
        }
    }

    /// Selects all items when the mode is [`Mode::Multiple`].
    #[must_use]
    pub fn select_all(&self) -> Self {
        if self.mode != Mode::Multiple {
            return self.clone();
        }

        Self {
            selected_keys: Set::All,
            ..self.clone()
        }
    }

    /// Clears the selection.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn clear(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            selected_keys: Set::Empty,
            anchor_key: None,
            selection_mode_active: false,
            ..self.clone()
        }
    }

    /// Extends the selection from the current anchor to `key`.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn extend_selection<T: Clone, C: Collection<T>>(&self, key: Key, collection: &C) -> Self {
        if self.mode == Mode::None {
            return self.clone();
        }

        if self.mode == Mode::Single {
            return self.select(key);
        }

        let anchor = match &self.anchor_key {
            Some(anchor) => anchor.clone(),
            None => return self.select(key),
        };

        if !collection.contains_key(&anchor) {
            return self.select(key);
        }

        let mut in_range = false;
        let mut range_keys = BTreeSet::new();

        for node in collection.nodes() {
            if !node.is_focusable() {
                continue;
            }

            let is_anchor = node.key == anchor;
            let is_target = node.key == key;

            if is_anchor || is_target {
                in_range = !in_range;

                if !self.is_disabled(&node.key) {
                    range_keys.insert(node.key.clone());
                }
            } else if in_range && !self.is_disabled(&node.key) {
                range_keys.insert(node.key.clone());
            }

            if is_anchor && is_target {
                break;
            }
        }

        let existing = match &self.selected_keys {
            Set::Multiple(selected) => selected.clone(),
            _ => BTreeSet::new(),
        };

        let merged = existing.into_iter().chain(range_keys).collect();

        Self {
            selected_keys: Set::Multiple(merged),
            focused_key: Some(key),
            ..self.clone()
        }
    }

  "content": "//! Table data-display component machine.\n//!\n//! Owns row/column selection, sort descriptors, expansion, grid focus,\n//! optional column-resize state, optional virtual-scrolling metadata, and\n//! the registered row list. The agnostic core never moves DOM focus,\n//! never measures column widths, never observes scroll, and never reads\n//! the rendered cell contents — adapters apply DOM focus by inspecting\n//! [`Context::focused_cell`] / [`Context::focused_row`] /\n//! [`Context::focused_col`], and observe pointer events to drive\n//! [`Event::ColumnResize`] / [`Event::ColumnResizeEnd`].\n//!\n//! Sort state lives exclusively in [`Context::sort_descriptor`] (spec\n//! §1.1.1). [`State`] has a single `Idle` variant; the visual sort\n//! spinner is gated on [`Context::is_sorting`].\n//!\n//! Direction resolution: [`Props::dir`] is mirrored into\n//! [`Context::dir`] at [`Machine::init`] time. Adapters must dispatch\n//! [`Event::SetDirection`] from [`Machine::on_props_changed`] (and on\n//! mount when the prop is [`Direction::Auto`] — the runtime-resolved\n//! concrete value is passed in) so RTL keyboard navigation stays live.\n//!\n//! Row registry: the machine tracks the rendered row list via\n//! [`Context::rows`], replaced by [`Event::SetRows`]. The registry\n//! powers `disallow_empty_selection` pruning and the\n//! `aria-rowcount`/`aria-rowindex` derivations for virtual scrolling.\n//! Keyboard helpers ([`Api::on_row_keydown`], [`Api::on_cell_keydown`])\n//! still accept an `all_row_ids` slice so adapters can pass the rendered\n//! row order without an extra registry round-trip.\n//!\n//! See `spec/components/data-display/table.md` for the full contract,\n//! plus §5 (SelectAll), §6 (Column Resizing), §3.5 (Virtual Scrolling),\n//! and §1.6 (Async loading).\n\nuse alloc::{\n    borrow::ToOwned,\n    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},\n    format,\n    string::{String, ToString as _},\n    vec::Vec,\n};\nuse core::fmt::{self, Debug};\n\nuse ars_collections::{Key, SortDescriptor, SortDirection, selection};\nuse ars_core::{\n    AriaAttr, AttrMap, Bindable, ComponentIds, ComponentMessages, ComponentPart, ConnectApi,\n    Direction, Env, HtmlAttr, Locale, MessageFn, NoEffect, TransitionPlan,\n};\nuse ars_interactions::{KeyboardEventData, KeyboardKey};\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests;\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// State\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// States for the [`Table`](self) component.\n///\n/// The table machine never changes state — every interaction (sort,\n/// selection, expansion, grid focus, column resize, virtual scroll)\n/// is expressed as a context mutation. Sort state in particular lives\n/// exclusively in [`Context::sort_descriptor`] per spec §1.1.1.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum State {\n    /// The table is at rest.\n    #[default]\n    Idle,\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Escape-key behavior\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Controls behavior when Escape is pressed while rows are selected.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum EscapeKeyBehavior {\n    /// Escape clears the current selection (default).\n    #[default]\n    ClearSelection,\n\n    /// Escape is not handled by the Table.\n    None,\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// SelectAll mode (§5.1)\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Strategy for the SelectAll affordance.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum SelectAllMode {\n    /// No select-all affordance is rendered.\n    None,\n\n    /// Select all currently visible (rendered) rows. Default.\n    #[default]\n    AllVisible,\n\n    /// Select every row in the dataset, including rows not yet loaded.\n    /// `total_count` is the known cardinality.\n    AllData {\n        /// Total number of rows in the dataset.\n        total_count: usize,\n    },\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Events\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Events accepted by the [`Table`](self) state machine.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub enum Event {\n    /// Apply or toggle sort on the given column. Cycle is\n    /// `None → Ascending → Descending → None`.\n    SortColumn {\n        /// Column identifier the user activated.\n        column: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Mark a row as selected. Rejected when selection is disabled or\n    /// the row is in [`Context::disabled_keys`].\n    SelectRow(Key),\n\n    /// Remove a row from the selection. Honors\n    /// [`Context::disallow_empty_selection`].\n    DeselectRow(Key),\n\n    /// Select every row (`Mode::Multiple` only). Uses\n    /// [`selection::Set::All`].\n    SelectAll,\n\n    /// Clear the entire selection. Rejected when\n    /// [`Context::disallow_empty_selection`] would leave the table empty.\n    DeselectAll,\n\n    /// Flip the selection state of one row. Honors disabled and\n    /// `disallow_empty_selection`.\n    ToggleRow(Key),\n\n    /// Show the expanded content for a row. No-op when already\n    /// expanded or the row is disabled.\n    ExpandRow(Key),\n\n    /// Hide the expanded content for a row.\n    CollapseRow(Key),\n\n    /// Move the logical grid focus to a cell by `(col, row)` indices.\n    Focus {\n        /// `(col, row)` index pair.\n        cell: (usize, usize),\n    },\n\n    /// Remove focus from the grid. Clears\n    /// [`Context::focused_cell`] / [`Context::focused_row`] /\n    /// [`Context::focused_col`].\n    Blur,\n\n    /// Move the logical row focus to the supplied row key.\n    FocusRow(Key),\n\n    /// Move the logical grid focus to the supplied row + column pair.\n    FocusCell {\n        /// Row key receiving focus.\n        row: Key,\n        /// Column index receiving focus.\n        col: usize,\n        /// Zero-based index of `row` inside [`Context::rows`] (so the\n        /// transition can write `(col, row_index)` into\n        /// [`Context::focused_cell`] without re-scanning the row list).\n        row_index: usize,\n    },\n\n    /// Primary action triggered on a row (Enter, double-click).\n    RowAction(Key),\n\n    /// User pressed Escape. Honors\n    /// [`Context::escape_key_behavior`].\n    EscapeKey,\n\n    /// Replace the registered row list. Stale selection / expansion /\n    /// focused row keys are pruned.\n    SetRows(Vec<Key>),\n\n    /// Replace [`Context::dir`]. Idempotent.\n    SetDirection(Direction),\n\n    /// Replace the virtualized total row / column counts (§3.5).\n    SetRowCounts {\n        /// Total row count across the entire dataset.\n        total_rows: usize,\n        /// Total column count across the entire dataset.\n        total_cols: usize,\n    },\n\n    /// Toggle the async loading indicator (§1.6).\n    SetLoading(bool),\n\n    /// Update the cached width for `column`. Clamps to\n    /// [`Context::min_column_width`] and upserts the entry on first\n    /// resize. Records `column` as the currently resizing column.\n    ColumnResize {\n        /// Column identifier.\n        column: String,\n        /// Requested width in pixels (pre-clamp).\n        width: f64,\n    },\n\n    /// Clear [`Context::resizing_column`] when it matches `column`.\n    ColumnResizeEnd {\n        /// Column identifier whose drag ended.\n        column: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Re-apply non-Bindable `Props` fields and re-prune\n    /// selection/expansion against new `disabled_keys`.\n    SyncProps,\n\n    /// Push a new controlled value into [`Context::selected_rows`].\n    SyncControlledSelectedRows(Option<selection::Set>),\n\n    /// Push a new controlled value into [`Context::expanded_rows`].\n    SyncControlledExpandedRows(Option<BTreeSet<Key>>),\n\n    /// Push a new controlled value into [`Context::sort_descriptor`].\n    SyncControlledSortDescriptor(Option<SortDescriptor<String>>),\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Messages\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Closure signature for the localized label messages.\n///\n/// Receives the active [`Locale`] and returns the localized string.\npub type LocaleFn = dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync;\n\n/// Closure signature for the SelectAll label which may take a row count.\n///\n/// Receives the total row count (or `0` when none is known) and the\n/// active [`Locale`], and returns the localized \"Select all N rows\"\n/// label.\npub type SelectAllLabelFn = dyn Fn(usize, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync;\n\n/// Localizable strings for [`Table`](self).\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct Messages {\n    /// Accessible label for the SelectAll checkbox. Receives the total\n    /// row count (`0` when unknown) so [`SelectAllMode::AllData`] can\n    /// render \"Select all 1,204 rows\".\n    pub select_all: MessageFn<SelectAllLabelFn>,\n\n    /// Accessible label for a row's selection checkbox.\n    pub select_row: MessageFn<LocaleFn>,\n\n    /// Announcement fired when a column is sorted ascending.\n    pub sort_ascending: MessageFn<LocaleFn>,\n\n    /// Announcement fired when a column is sorted descending.\n    pub sort_descending: MessageFn<LocaleFn>,\n\n    /// Announcement fired when sort is removed.\n    pub sort_none: MessageFn<LocaleFn>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Messages {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            select_all: MessageFn::new(|count: usize, _locale: &Locale| {\n                if count == 0 {\n                    \"Select all rows\".to_string()\n                } else {\n                    format!(\"Select all {count} rows\")\n                }\n            }),\n            select_row: MessageFn::new(|_locale: &Locale| \"Select row\".to_string()),\n            sort_ascending: MessageFn::new(|_locale: &Locale| \"Sort ascending\".to_string()),\n            sort_descending: MessageFn::new(|_locale: &Locale| \"Sort descending\".to_string()),\n            sort_none: MessageFn::new(|_locale: &Locale| \"Remove sort\".to_string()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ComponentMessages for Messages {}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Props\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Immutable configuration for a [`Table`](self) instance.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, ars_core::HasId)]\npub struct Props {\n    /// Component instance id. Required.\n    pub id: String,\n\n    // ── Selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Controlled selected rows.\n    pub selected_rows: Option<selection::Set>,\n\n    /// Uncontrolled initial selection. Disabled rows are pruned during\n    /// [`Machine::init`].\n    pub default_selected_rows: selection::Set,\n\n    /// Row selection mode.\n    pub selection_mode: selection::Mode,\n\n    /// Controls whether selection toggles or replaces on click.\n    pub selection_behavior: selection::Behavior,\n\n    /// Keys of individually disabled rows.\n    pub disabled_keys: BTreeSet<Key>,\n\n    /// Forbid deselecting the last remaining selected row.\n    pub disallow_empty_selection: bool,\n\n    /// Behavior when Escape is pressed while rows are selected.\n    pub escape_key_behavior: EscapeKeyBehavior,\n\n    /// SelectAll affordance strategy (§5).\n    pub select_all_mode: SelectAllMode,\n\n    // ── Expansion ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Controlled expanded rows.\n    pub expanded_rows: Option<BTreeSet<Key>>,\n\n    /// Uncontrolled initial expansion.\n    pub default_expanded_rows: BTreeSet<Key>,\n\n    // ── Sort ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Controlled/uncontrolled sort state.\n    pub sort_descriptor: Bindable<Option<SortDescriptor<String>>>,\n\n    // ── Layout & a11y ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Enables `role=\"grid\"` with full keyboard cell navigation.\n    pub interactive: bool,\n\n    /// Fixes the `<thead>` while the `<tbody>` scrolls.\n    pub sticky_header: bool,\n\n    /// Optional visible caption text. When `Some`, the table renders\n    /// `aria-labelledby` pointing at the caption's id.\n    pub caption: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Text direction. `Direction::Auto` resolves from the active\n    /// locale at [`Machine::init`] time.\n    pub dir: Direction,\n\n    // ── Column resizing (§6) ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Minimum allowed column width in pixels.\n    pub min_column_width: f64,\n\n    /// Keyboard width-adjustment step in pixels.\n    pub column_resize_step: f64,\n\n    // ── Virtual scrolling (§3.5) ─────────────────────────────────────\n    /// When `true`, the table emits `aria-rowcount` / `aria-colcount`\n    /// and rows emit `aria-rowindex`.\n    pub virtual_scrolling: bool,\n\n    /// Total row count in the dataset (not just visible rows).\n    pub total_rows: usize,\n\n    /// Total column count in the dataset.\n    pub total_cols: usize,\n\n    // ── Async loading (§1.6) ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    /// Async loading flag. Adapters render skeleton rows when `true`.\n    pub loading: Bindable<bool>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Props {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            id: String::new(),\n            selected_rows: None,\n            default_selected_rows: selection::Set::default(),\n            selection_mode: selection::Mode::None,\n            selection_behavior: selection::Behavior::Toggle,\n            disabled_keys: BTreeSet::new(),\n            disallow_empty_selection: false,\n            escape_key_behavior: EscapeKeyBehavior::ClearSelection,\n            select_all_mode: SelectAllMode::default(),\n            expanded_rows: None,\n            default_expanded_rows: BTreeSet::new(),\n            sort_descriptor: Bindable::uncontrolled(None),\n            interactive: false,\n            sticky_header: false,\n            caption: None,\n            dir: Direction::default(),\n            min_column_width: 50.0,\n            column_resize_step: 10.0,\n            virtual_scrolling: false,\n            total_rows: 0,\n            total_cols: 0,\n            loading: Bindable::uncontrolled(false),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Context\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Runtime context for the [`Table`](self) machine.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct Context {\n    /// Currently selected row IDs.\n    pub selected_rows: Bindable<selection::Set>,\n\n    /// Full selection state machine (mode, behavior, anchor, focus,\n    /// disabled keys).\n    pub selection_state: selection::State,\n\n    /// Currently expanded row IDs (expansion is unrelated to selection).\n    pub expanded_rows: Bindable<BTreeSet<Key>>,\n\n    /// Unified sort state. `None` means no active sort.\n    pub sort_descriptor: Bindable<Option<SortDescriptor<String>>>,\n\n    /// True while an async sort is in progress (drives sort-indicator\n    /// visuals only; the canonical state is `sort_descriptor`).\n    pub is_sorting: bool,\n\n    /// Grid focus position: `(col_index, row_index)`. None when\n    /// unfocused.\n    pub focused_cell: Option<(usize, usize)>,\n\n    /// Focused row key for row-level keyboard navigation.\n    pub focused_row: Option<Key>,\n\n    /// Focused column index for cell-level keyboard navigation.\n    pub focused_col: Option<usize>,\n\n    /// Keys of individually disabled rows.\n    pub disabled_keys: BTreeSet<Key>,\n\n    /// Row selection mode.\n    pub selection_mode: selection::Mode,\n\n    /// When `true`, the table renders `role=\"grid\"`.\n    pub interactive: bool,\n\n    /// Registered row keys, replaced via [`Event::SetRows`].\n    pub the entire dataset.\n    pub total_rows: usize,\n\n    /// Total column count across the entire dataset.\n    pub total_cols: usize,\n\n    /// Async loading flag (§1.6).\n    pub loading: the last selected row is forbidden.\n    pub disallow_empty_selection: bool,\n\n    /// Whether the `<thead>` is fixed while the `<tbody>` scrolls.\n    pub sticky_header: bool,\n\n    /// Resolved {\n        /// Row identifier.\n        key: Key,\n    },\n    /// A `<th scope=\"col\">` column header.\n    ColumnHeader {\n        /// Column identifier.\n        header: String,\n    },\n    /// A `<th scope=\"row\">` row header cell.\n    RowHeader,\n    /// A `<td>` data cell.\n    Cell {\n        /// Column index.\n        col: usize,\n        /// Row index.\n        row: usize,\n    },\n    /// The SelectAll checkbox in the header.\n    SelectAllCheckbox,\n    /// The per-row selection checkbox.\n    RowCheckbox {\n        /// Row identifier.\n        key: Key,\n    },\n    /// The expand/collapse trigger for an expandable row.\n    ExpandTrigger {\n        /// Row identifier.\n        key: Key,\n    },\n    /// The expanded detail content for a row.\n    ExpandedContent {\n ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers (selection / row registry pruning)\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Removes disabled keys from a [`selection::Set`].\nfn prune_selection_against(set: &selection::Set, disabled: &BTreeSet<Key>) -> selection::Set {\n    match set {\n        selection::Set::Empty | selection::Set::All => set.clone(),\n        selection::Set::Single(key) => {\n            if disabled.contains(key) {\n                selection::Set::Empty\n            } else {\n                selection::Set::Single(key.clone())\n            }\n        }\n        selection::Set::Multiple(keys) => {\n            let pruned: BTreeSet<Key> = keys.iter().filter(|k| !disabled.contains(k)).cloned().collect();\n            match pruned.len() {\n                0 => selection::Set::Empty,\n                1 => selection::Set::Single(pruned.into_iter().next().unwrap()),\n                _ => selection::Set::Multiple(pruned),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Restricts a [`selection::Set`] to keys present in `rows`. `All` is\n/// preserved (it logically expands to the registered set).\nfn restrict_selection_to_rows(set: &selection::Set, rows: &[Key]) -> selection::Set {\n    match set {\n        selection::Set::Empty | selection::Set::All => set.clone(),\n        selection::Set::Single(key) => {\n            if rows.contains(key) {\n                selection::Set::Single(key.clone())\n            } else {\n                selection::Set::Empty\n            }\n        }\n        selection::Set::Multiple(keys) => {\n            let pruned: BTreeSet<Key> = keys.iter().filter(|k| rows.contains(k)).cloned().collect();\n            match pruned.len() {\n                0 => selection::Set::Empty,\n                1 => selection::Set::Single(pruned.into_iter().next().unwrap()),\n                _ => selection::Set::Multiple(pruned),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Toggle helper that avoids the `Collection` generic on\n/// [`selection::State::toggle`]. The Table machine intentionally does\n/// not own a `Collection`, so it computes toggle directly from the\n/// `selection::Set::All` case.\nfn toggle_state_without_collection(state: &selection::State, key: Key) -> selection::State {\n    if state.is_disabled(&key) {\n        return state.clone();\n    }\n\n    if state.is_selected(&key) {\n        // `selection::State::deselect_from_all` requires a Collection;\n        // expand `All` to `Multiple(rows \\ {key})` below by caller —\n        // here we simply call `deselect` which handles `Set::All` by\n        // returning the state unchanged. The caller pre-handles `All`.\n        state.deselect(&key)\n    } else {\n        state.select(key)\n    }\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Machine\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// State machine for the [`Table`](self) component.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Effect = NoEffect;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;\n\n    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {\n        let locale = env.locale.clone();\n        let messages = messages.clone();\n        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);\n\n        let pruned_default_selection =\n            prune_selection_against(&props.default_selected_rows, &props.disabled_keys);\n        let pruned_default_expansion: BTreeSet<Key> = props\n            .default_expanded_rows\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|key| !props.disabled_keys.contains(key))\n            .cloned()\n            .collect();\n\n        let initial_selection = match &props.selected_rows {\n            Some(controlled) => controlled.clone(),\n            None => pruned_default_selection.clone(),\n        };\n\n        let selection_state = selection::State::new(props.selection_mode, props.selection_behavior)\n            .with_disabled(props.disabled_keys.clone());\n        let selection_state = selection::State {\n            selected_keys: initial_selection,\n            ..selection_state\n        };\n\n        let dir = if props.dir == Direction::Auto {\n            // Resolve `Auto → concrete` from the active locale. Adapters\n            // can override via `Event::SetDirection` if the platform\n            // provides a more authoritative resolution.\n            locale.direction()\n        } else {\n            props.dir\n        };\n\n        let ctx = Context {\n            selected_rows: match &props.selected_rows {\n                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),\n                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(pruned_default_selection),\n            },\n            selection_state,\n            expanded_rows: match &props.expanded_rows {\n                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),\n                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(pruned_default_expansion),\n            },\n            sort_descriptor: props.sort_descriptor.clone(),\n            is_sorting: false,\n            focused_cell: None,\n            focused_row: None,\n            focused_col: None,\n            disabled_keys: props.disabled_keys.clone(),\n            selection_mode: props.selection_mode,\n            interactive: props.interactive,\n            rows: Vec::new(),\n            dir,\n            column_widths: BTreeMap::new(),\n            resizing_column: None,\n            virtual_scrolling: props.virtual_scrolling,\n            total_rows: props.total_rows,\n            total_cols: props.total_cols,\n            loading: props.loading.clone(),\n            escape_key_behavior: props.escape_key_behavior,\n            select_all_mode: props.select_all_mode.clone(),\n            min_column_width: props.min_column_width,\n            column_resize_step: props.column_resize_step,\n            disallow_empty_selection: props.disallow_empty_selection,\n            sticky_header: props.sticky_header,\n            locale,\n            messages,\n            caption_id: ids.part(\"caption\"),\n            id: ids.id().to_string(),\n        };\n\n        (State::Idle, ctx)\n    }\n\n    fn transition(\n        _state: &Self::State,\n        event: &Self::Event,\n        ctx: &Self::Context,\n        _props: &Self::Props,\n    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {\n        match event {\n            // ── Sort ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n            // Sort state lives entirely in `ctx.sort_descriptor`. The\n            // single-column cycle is None → Ascending → Descending → None.\n            Event::SortColumn { column } => {\n                let current = ctx.sort_descriptor.get().clone();\n                let new_descriptor = match current {\n                    Some(desc) if desc.column == *column => match desc.direction {\n                        SortDirection::Ascending => Some(SortDescriptor {\n                            column: column.clone(),\n                            direction: SortDirection::Descending,\n                        }),\n                        SortDirection::Descending => None,\n                    },\n                    _ => Some(SortDescriptor {\n                        column: column.clone(),\n                        direction: SortDirection::Ascending,\n                    }),\n                };\n\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.sort_descriptor.set(new_descriptor);\n                    ctx.is_sorting = true;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Row Action ───────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::RowAction(key) => {\n                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                // Notification only — adapter listens for the event.\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|_ctx| {}))\n            }\n\n            // ── Selection ────────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SelectRow(key) => {\n                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.selection_state.is_selected(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select(key);\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::DeselectRow(key) => {\n                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if !ctx.selection_state.is_selected(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disallow_empty_selection\n                    && would_empty_after_deselect(&ctx.selection_state.selected_keys, key)\n                {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.deselect(&key);\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::ToggleRow(key) => {\n                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let is_currently_selected = ctx.selection_state.is_selected(key);\n                if is_currently_selected\n                    && ctx.disallow_empty_selection\n                    && would_empty_after_deselect(&ctx.selection_state.selected_keys, key)\n                {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let new_state = toggle_state_without_collection(&ctx.selection_state, key);\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::SelectAll => {\n                if ctx.selection_mode != selection::Mode::Multiple {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if matches!(ctx.selected_rows.get(), selection::Set::All) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select_all();\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::DeselectAll => {\n                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if matches!(ctx.selected_rows.get(), selection::Set::Empty) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disallow_empty_selection {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.clear();\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Expansion ────────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::ExpandRow(key) => {\n                if ctx.disabled_keys.contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.expanded_rows.get().contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let mut rows = ctx.expanded_rows.get().clone();\n                    rows.insert(key);\n                    ctx.expanded_rows.set(rows);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::CollapseRow(key) => {\n                if !ctx.expanded_rows.get().contains(key) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let mut rows = ctx.expanded_rows.get().clone();\n                    rows.remove(&key);\n                    ctx.expanded_rows.set(rows);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Grid focus ───────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::Focus { cell } => {\n                if !ctx.interactive {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let c = *cell;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.focused_cell = Some(c);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                ctx.focused_cell = None;\n                ctx.focused_row = None;\n                ctx.focused_col = None;\n            })),\n\n            Event::FocusRow(key) => {\n                if !ctx.interactive {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let key = key.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.focused_row = Some(key);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::FocusCell { row, col, row_index } => {\n                if !ctx.interactive {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let r = row.clone();\n                let c = *col;\n                let ri = *row_index;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.focused_cell = Some((c, ri));\n                    ctx.focused_row = Some(r);\n                    ctx.focused_col = Some(c);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Escape key ───────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::EscapeKey => {\n                if ctx.escape_key_behavior != EscapeKeyBehavior::ClearSelection {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if ctx.disallow_empty_selection {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                if matches!(ctx.selected_rows.get(), selection::Set::Empty) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.clear();\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Row registry ─────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SetRows(new_rows) => {\n                let rows = new_rows.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    let restricted_selection =\n                        restrict_selection_to_rows(&ctx.selected_rows.get().clone(), &rows);\n                    let restricted_expansion: BTreeSet<Key> = ctx\n                        .expanded_rows\n                        .get()\n                        .iter()\n                        .filter(|k| rows.contains(k))\n                        .cloned()\n                        .collect();\n\n                    if let Some(focused) = ctx.focused_row.clone() {\n                        if !rows.contains(&focused) {\n                            ctx.focused_row = None;\n                            ctx.focused_cell = None;\n                            ctx.focused_col = None;\n                        }\n                    }\n\n                    ctx.selected_rows.set(restricted_selection.clone());\n                    ctx.selection_state.selected_keys = restricted_selection;\n                    ctx.expanded_rows.set(restricted_expansion);\n                    ctx.rows = rows;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Direction ────────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SetDirection(dir) => {\n                if ctx.dir == *dir {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let d = *dir;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.dir = d;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Virtual scroll counts ────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SetRowCounts { total_rows, total_cols } => {\n                if ctx.total_rows == *total_rows && ctx.total_cols == *total_cols {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let tr = *total_rows;\n                let tc = *total_cols;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.total_rows = tr;\n                    ctx.total_cols = tc;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Async loading ────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SetLoading(value) => {\n                if *ctx.loading.get() == *value {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                let v = *value;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.loading.set(v);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Column resize ────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::ColumnResize { column, width } => {\n                let min = ctx.min_column_width;\n                let clamped = if *width < min { min } else { *width };\n                let col = column.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.column_widths.insert(col.clone(), clamped);\n                    ctx.resizing_column = Some(col);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::ColumnResizeEnd { column } => {\n                if ctx.resizing_column.as_deref() != Some(column.as_str()) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                    ctx.resizing_column = None;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            // ── Prop sync ────────────────────────────────────────────\n            Event::SyncProps => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {\n                let disabled = ctx.disabled_keys.clone();\n                let pruned_selection =\n                    prune_selection_against(&ctx.selected_rows.get().clone(), &disabled);\n                let pruned_expansion: BTreeSet<Key> = ctx\n                    .expanded_rows\n                    .get()\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|k| !disabled.contains(k))\n                    .cloned()\n                    .collect();\n\n                ctx.selected_rows.set(pruned_selection.clone());\n                ctx.selection_state.selected_keys = pruned_selection;\n                ctx.expanded_rows.set(pruned_expansion);\n            })),\n\n            Event::SyncControlledSelectedRows(value) => {\n                let v = value.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.selected_rows.sync_controlled(v.clone());\n                    if let Some(set) = v {\n                        ctx.selection_state.selected_keys = set;\n                    }\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::SyncControlledExpandedRows(value) => {\n                let v = value.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.expanded_rows.sync_controlled(v);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::SyncControlledSortDescriptor(value) => {\n                let v = value.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {\n                    ctx.sort_descriptor.sync_controlled(v);\n                    ctx.is_sorting = false;\n                }))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a Self::State,\n        ctx: &'a Self::Context,\n        props: &'a Self::Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),\n    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {\n        Api { state, ctx, props, send }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Returns `true` when deselecting `key` would leave the selection empty.\nfn would_empty_after_deselect(set: &selection::Set, key: &Key) -> bool {\n    match set {\n        selection::Set::Empty => false,\n        selection::Set::Single(k) => k == key,\n        selection::Set::Multiple(keys) => keys.len() == 1 && keys.contains(key),\n        selection::Set::All => false,\n    }\n}\n\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Api\n// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Connect API for the [`Table`](self) component.\npub struct Api<'a> {\n    state: &'a State,\n    ctx: &'a Context,\n    props: &'a Props,\n    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),\n}\n\nimpl<'a> Debug for Api<'a> {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"Api\")\n            .field(\"state\", self.state)\n            .field(\"ctx\", self.ctx)\n            .field(\"props\", self.props)\n            .finish_non_exhaustive()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<'a> Api<'a> {\n    /// Returns the underlying machine state.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn state(&self) -> &State {\n        self.state\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the underlying context.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn context(&self) -> &Context {\n        self.ctx\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the underlying props.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn props(&self) -> &Props {\n        self.props\n    }\n\n    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Returns `true` when `row_id` is currently selected.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_row_selected(&self, row_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.selected_rows.get().contains(row_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns `true` when `row_id` is currently expanded.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_row_expanded(&self, row_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.expanded_rows.get().contains(row_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns `true` when `row_id` is in the disabled set.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_row_disabled(&self, row_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.disabled_keys.contains(row_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current sort descriptor.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn sort_descriptor(&self) -> Option<&SortDescriptor<String>> {\n        self.ctx.sort_descriptor.get().as_ref()\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the active sort column, if any.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn active_sort_column(&self) -> Option<&String> {\n        self.sort_descriptor().map(|d| &d.column)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current sort direction for the active sort column.\n    /// Returns `None` when no column is sorted (per\n    /// [`SortDirection`]'s definition `Ascending`/`Descending` only).\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn sort_direction(&self) -> Option<SortDirection> {\n        self.sort_descriptor().map(|d| d.direction)\n    }\n\n    /// Returns `true` when every key in `all_row_ids` is currently\n    /// selected. Handles [`selection::Set::All`] efficiently.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn all_selected(&self, all_row_ids: &[&Key]) -> bool {\n        let sel = self.ctx.selected_rows.get();\n        if sel.is_all() {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if all_row_ids.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        all_row_ids.iter().all(|id| sel.contains(id))\n    }\n\n    /// Returns `true` when at least one key in `all_row_ids` is\n    /// currently selected.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn some_selected(&self, all_row_ids: &[&Key]) -> bool {\n        let sel = self.ctx.selected_rows.get();\n        if sel.is_all() {\n            return !all_row_ids.is_empty();\n        }\n        all_row_ids.iter().any(|id| sel.contains(id))\n    }\n\n    // ── Root / Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the wrapper `<div>`.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Root);\n        if self.ctx.sticky_header {\n            p.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-sticky-header\"), true);\n        }\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the `<table>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn table_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        p.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.id.clone());\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Table);\n        if self.ctx.interactive {\n            p.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"grid\");\n        } else {\n            p.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"table\");\n        }\n        if self.props.caption.is_some() {\n            p.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), self.ctx.caption_id.clone());\n        }\n        if self.ctx.virtual_scrolling {\n            p.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::RowCount), self.ctx.total_rows.to_string());\n            p.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ColCount), self.ctx.total_cols.to_string());\n        }\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the `<caption>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn caption_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        p.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.caption_id.clone());\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Caption);\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the `<thead>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn head_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Head);\n        if self.ctx.sticky_header {\n            p.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-sticky\"), true);\n        }\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the `<tbody>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn body_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Body);\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for the `<tfoot>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn foot_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut p = AttrMap::new();\n        set_part(&mut p, &Part::Foot);\n        p\n    }\n\n    // ── Rows ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Returns the attribute map for a `<tr>` row.\n    ///\n    /// `row_index` is the zero-based position of the row in the rendered\n
